title: Inversion and Emphasis / Inversion na Gutangaza
bridge: Mu gaciri, kugira ngo dufate amabanga, tukoresha ubwoko bw’inyungu canke kwinjira amagambo nk’‘sî que’ cyangwa ‘es que’, ariko mu Icyongereza, gutangaza bishobora kugirwa no guhindura ubwoko bw’umuntu n’igikorwa cyangwa gutekereza ubwoko bw’amagambo nk’‘not only... but also’ cyangwa ‘so + adjective... that’. Ibiki bikorwa bishobora kuba bigaragara nk’ibintu bitandukanye kuri abanyarwanda kubera ko mu gaciri, gutangaza nta kindi, usibye mu ibibazo cyangwa mu bihe bitandukanye. Ikibazo k’umwanya ni kugira ubwoko bw’SVO mu Icyongereza ubwo ari ubwoko bw’inversion, kugira amagambo atandukanye nk’‘Not only he arrived late’ ahubwo ‘Not only did he arrive late’.
rule: Inversion mu Icyongereza bishobora kugirwa kugira ngo dufate amabanga cyangwa mu bihe bitandukanye. Bishobora kugirwa mu bihe ibyalandikwe: 1) Nyuma y’amagambo yo kwibuka nk’‘never’, ‘rarely’, ‘seldom’, ‘hardly’, ‘scarcely’, ‘no sooner’, ‘not only’, ‘not until’, ‘little’, ‘in no way’. Mu bihe ibyalandikwe, umubare w’abantu (do/does/did, have/has, will, etc.) ubwoko bw’umuntu n’igikorwa, kandi igikorwa k’umuntu kirimo ‘to’. Inyu: ‘Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.’ 2) N’ubwoko bw’‘so + adjective/adverb’ na ‘such + noun’ ku mwishura w’amagambo kugira ngo dufate amabanga cyangwa kugira ubwoko bw’amagambo, nyuma y’‘that’ (ariko ‘that’ bishobora kugira ubwoko bw’amagambo): ‘So beautiful was the painting that everyone stared.’ 3) Kugira ngo dufate amabanga n’ubwoko bw’‘not only... but also’, ‘only after’, ‘only if’, etc. 4) Mu bihe bitandukanye bishobora kugirwa ubwoko bw’umuntu n’igikorwa mu ‘if’ ubwoko bw’amagambo: ‘Had I known, I would have come.’ 5) N’ubwoko bw’‘here’ na ‘there’ ubwo igikorwa kirimo umuntu, nta kindi, usibye umuntu. 6) Mu bihe bitandukanye n’ubwoko bw’‘may’ (bitandukanye). Ikiganiro: mu Icyongereza, nta kindi, usibye mu bihe bitandukanye (ahubwo mu gaciri mu bihe cyangwa mu bihe bitandukanye), kandi nta kindi, usibye mu bihe bitandukanye. Nta kindi, usibye ko inversion n’ubwoko bw’amagambo yo kwibuka bishobora kugira ubwoko bw’abantu, nta kindi, usibye mu bihe bitandukanye.

common_error.wrong: Not only he has a beautiful voice, but also he sings well.
common_error.correct: Not only does he have a beautiful voice, but he also sings well.
common_error.correct_alt: Not only does he have a beautiful voice, but he also sings well.
common_error.explanation: Ikibazo kishobora kugirwa kubera ko mu gaciri, tusanga ‘Nta kindi yashize umwanya, ahubwo yashize no kwimura’, kugira ubwoko bw’umuntu n’igikorwa. Ariko mu Icyongereza, ubwo ubushyuhe bw’amagambo bw’‘not only’, bishobora kugirwa ubwoko bw’umubare w’abantu n’umuntu. Ubwoko bw’‘does’ bishobora kugirwa mu bihe bitandukanye, kandi igikorwa k’umuntu kirimo ‘have’ kirimo ubwoko bw’amagambo. Nta kindi, usibye ko inversion n’ubwoko bw’amagambo yo kwibuka bishobora kugira ubwoko bw’abantu, nta kindi, usibye mu bihe bitandukanye. Kugira ngo dufate ikibazo, remera ko nyuma y’‘not only’, ‘never’, ‘rarely’, etc., ubwoko bw’amagambo ni: umubare w’abantu + umuntu + igikorwa k’umuntu.

title: Register and Style: Formal, Informal, and Neutral / Ibinyacumu n’Umwete: Ifomali, Ntifomali, na Karenge
bridge: Mu gaciri, ibinyacumu birangurwa kenshi n’ubushobozi bwo kugena ‘tú’/’usted’, ariko mu Icyongereza, ubwoko bw’ibinyacumu bukomoka n’ubushobozi, imirimo y’inyungu, n’amagambo menshi. Ikibazo kinini ni gufatanya ubwoko bw’ibinyacumu n’amagambo menshi yongeye kuba y’ubushake cyangwa y’ubwoko bw’ibinyacumu. Uyu munshiro, ‘I am writing to you in order to request...’ ni ifomali, ariko ‘I’m writing to ask...’ ni karenge mu mico y’ubushakashatsi bw’ubu. Ikintu kinini ni kumenya ibikorwa by’ubwoko bw’ibinyacumu buri munsi kandi gufata ibinyacumu by’ubwoko bw’ibinyacumu.
rule: Mu Icyongereza C1, ubwoko bw’ibinyacumu bukomoka mu mirimo y’inyungu (e.g., ‘get’ vs ‘obtain’, ‘show’ vs ‘demonstrate’), mu mirimo y’inyungu (ubushobozi bw’ubwoko bw’ibinyacumu, imirimo y’inyungu yongeye, imirimo y’inyungu) n’ubushobozi bw’ubwoko bw’ibinyacumu (imirimo y’ubwoko bw’ibinyacumu, ubushobozi bw’ubwoko bw’ibinyacumu). Ubwoko bw’ibinyacumu bw’ifomali bukoreshwa mu makuru y’ishuri, ibaro ry’ubushakashatsi, n’ibiro; kenshi bishimishwa n’ubushobozi bw’ubwoko bw’ibinyacumu (‘It was decided...’), amagambo y’ubwoko bw’ibinyacumu, n’imirimo y’inyungu yongeye (‘furthermore’, ‘nevertheless’). Ubwoko bw’ibinyacumu bw’ntifomali bukomoka mu mico y’ubushakashatsi, ibaro ry’abagenzi; bukoresha ubushobozi bw’ubwoko bw’ibinyacumu, imirimo y’inyungu (e.g., ‘put off’ aho kuba ‘postpone’), n’ubushobozi bw’ubwoko bw’ibinyacumu. Ubwoko bw’ibinyacumu bw’karenge ni bwiza mu mico y’ubushakashatsi bw’ubwoko bw’ibinyacumu: karenge, kiroroshye, nta jyanye. Kuri C1, ni kinyegeje kumenya ubwoko bw’ibinyacumu buri munsi kandi gufata ibinyacumu by’ubwoko bw’ibinyacumu.

title: Advanced Inversion and Fronting / Inversion na Frontalization yo Kurema
bridge: Mu gaciriyano, inversion (gutanga umubare w’ishushanyo uri mbere y’umusubirwa) ntibiyongeye gushtuka mu ibibazo gusa, ahubwo bikoreshwa no kugera umusanzu cyangwa kugira inyungu y’umwanditsi. Mu ikinyarwanda, dusanga icyo kimwe n’umusanzu n’uburyo bwo kwivugana cyangwe gutunga ibintu mu buryo bwo kubanza n’umusubirwa. Nk’akabanga, ‘Rarely have I seen such beauty’ mu ikinyarwanda bishobora kuba ‘Rara hejye nabonaga uburyarya nk’ubwo’, bigatanga inversion. Ikibazo kiri mu kumenya ko mu ikinyarwanda, inversion bikwiye kuba mu ibibazo bishushanye gusa, nyamara mu gaciriyano bikwiye kuba n’mu amazina y’amoko y’amagambo menshi cyangwa iby’ubushakashatsi.
rule: Inversion mu gaciriyano bikwiye kuba igihe amagambo menshi (amagambo menshi, iby’ubushakashatsi, cyangwa amagambo yo kumanuka n’ubushakashatsi) bikwiye kuba mbere y’amagambo. Mu bihe bikomeye, umubare w’ishushanyo (cyangwa umubare w’ishushanyo ‘be’) bikwiye kuba mbere y’umusubirwa, nk’uburyo bwo kwibaza. Imirimo ikomeye nshya nshya ni ibi: 1) Amagambo menshi: ‘never’, ‘rarely’, ‘seldom’, ‘hardly’, ‘scarcely’, ‘barely’, ‘no sooner’ - akabanga: ‘Never have I seen such a mess’. 2) Iby’ubushakashatsi: ‘not only...but also’, ‘only after’, ‘only by’, ‘only when’ - akabanga: ‘Only after the war did they return’. 3) Iby’ubushakashatsi n’ubushakashatsi n’ubushakashatsi - akabanga: ‘So beautiful was the sunset that we stopped’. 4) N’ubushakashatsi ‘not until’ cyangwa ‘not since’ - akabanga: ‘Not until midnight did the party end’. 5) N’ubushakashatsi ‘in no way’, ‘on no account’, ‘under no circumstances’. Wemera ko n’ubushakashatsi, ubishyira ‘do/does/did’ kugira ngo ubone inversion mu gaciriyano n’ubushakashatsi. Inversion ni ikimwe n’ubushakashatsi n’ubushakashatsi; mu kwivugana n’ubushakashatsi, ntibikwiye kuba n’ubushakashatsi, nyamara bikwiye kuba n’ubushakashatsi.

concept_examples.translation: Ntibikwiye kugura urugo ruwo mu bwa kuri buri ki.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈʌndər noʊ ˈsɜːrkəmstænsɪz ʃʊd juː ˈoʊpən ðæt dɔːr/

common_error.wrong: Rarely I have seen such a beautiful performance.
common_error.correct: Rarely have I seen such a beautiful performance.
common_error.correct_alt: I have rarely seen such a beautiful performance.
common_error.explanation: Ikibazo kishobora kugura mu kubwira ko mu ikinyarwanda, ntushobora gutanga umusubirwa n’umubare w’ishushanyo mu amazina y’amoko y’amagambo. Igihe ubishyira ‘Rara hejye nabonaga’ mu buryo bwo kwivugana, ubishyira inversion. Wemera: igihe ubishyira amagambo menshi cyangwa amagambo yo kumanuka n’ubushakashatsi mu mbere y’amagambo mu gaciriyano, bikwiye gutanga umubare w’ishushanyo n’umusubirwa, ubishyira ‘do/does/did’ n’ubushakashatsi. N’ubushakashatsi, ubishyira amagambo mu buryo bwo kwivugana (nyuma y’umubare w’ishushanyo) kandi ntibikwiye gutanga inversion.

examples.original: Never had she felt so alone.
examples.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər hæd ʃiː fɛlt soʊ əˈloʊn/
examples.translation: Nta kuba yabonaga ubushakashatsi nk’ubwo.
examples.note: Kugura ‘never’ mu mbere n’ubushakashatsi bwo hejye, gutanga ‘had’ n’umusubirwa.

examples.original: Rarely do we see such dedication.
examples.phonetic: /ˈrɛrli duː wiː siː sʌtʃ ˌdɛdɪˈkeɪʃən/
examples.translation: Rara hejye tubona ubushakashatsi nk’ubwo.
examples.note: N’ubushakashatsi bwo kwivugana, bikwiye gutanga ‘do’ kugira ngo ubone inversion.

examples.original: Hardly had the play started when the fire alarm went off.
examples.phonetic: /ˈhɑːrdli hæd ðə pleɪ ˈstɑːrtɪd wɛn ðə ˈfaɪər əˈlɑːrm wɛnt ɒf/
examples.translation: Nta gushishana gusa yishyize igishushanyo cye igihe yari yabonaga ubushakashatsi.
examples.note: Ubushakashatsi ‘hardly...when’ bikwiye gutanga inversion mu mbere y’amagambo n’ubushakashatsi bwo hejye.

examples.original: Only by working hard can you achieve your goals.
examples.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli baɪ ˈwɜːrkɪŋ hɑːrd kæn juː əˈtʃiːv jɔːr ɡoʊlz/
examples.translation: Gusa gutanga ubushakashatsi bikwiye kugira ngo ubone iby’ubushakashatsi byawe.
examples.note: N’ubushakashatsi ‘only by’ + gerund, inversion bikwiye kuba mu gaciriyano kirekire.

examples.original: Not until midnight did the storm subside.
examples.phonetic: /nɒt ənˈtɪl ˈmɪdnaɪt dɪd ðə stɔːrm səbˈsaɪd/
examples.translation: Nta kuba yabonaga ubushakashatsi kugeza hejye.
examples.note: N’ubushakashatsi ‘not until’, inversion bikwiye kuba mu gaciriyano kirekire, ntibikwiye kuba mu gaciriyano kirekire.

examples.original: Only when the last tree is cut down will we realize its importance.
examples.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wɛn ðə lɑːst triː ɪz kʌt daʊn wɪl wiː ˈriːəlaɪz ɪts ɪmˈpɔːrtəns/
examples.translation: Gusa igihe ubona ubwoko bw’ibiti byose ni ico ubona ubushakashatsi bwawe.
examples.note: Reeba ko inversion bikwiye kuba mu gaciriyano kirekire, ntibikwiye kuba mu gaciriyano kirekire n’ubushakashatsi ‘when’.

examples.original: So exhausted was she that she fell asleep instantly.
examples.phonetic: /soʊ ɪɡˈzɔːstɪd wʌz ʃiː ðæt ʃiː fɛl əˈsliːp ˈɪnstəntli/
examples.translation: Yari yabonaga ubushakashatsi nk’ubwo kugeza hejye yishyize.
examples.note: Inversion n’ubushakashatsi ‘so + adjetivo’ bikwiye kugira umusanzu mubihe.

examples.original: Such was the chaos that no one could hear the announcement.
examples.phonetic: /sʌtʃ wʌz ðə ˈkeɪɒs ðæt noʊ wʌn kʊd hɪər ði əˈnaʊnsmənt/
examples.translation: Ubwoko bw’ibiti bwari bworoshye kugeza hejye nta wari wumvise ubushakashatsi.
examples.note: ‘Such’ + umubare w’ishushanyo + igisubirwa; inversion bikwiye kuba n’umubare w’ishushanyo ‘be’.

examples.original: That film I would never watch again.
examples.phonetic: /ðæt fɪlm aɪ wʊd ˈnɛvər wɒtʃ əˈɡɛn/
examples.translation: Icyo gihe nta nshobora kubonaga ubushakashatsi nk’ubwo.
examples.note: Frontalization bigatanga inversion: bikwiye gutanga igisubirwa kugira ngo ubone umusanzu, nyamara uburyo bwo kwivugana n’umusubirwa bukwiye kugira.
